assume	splinter count = floor(item Weight / 0.2), min 1	weights from scripts/generated/items/*.txt; a weight change in an update changes the fair count (rerun tools/gen_recipes.py)
assume	Plank weighs 3.0 = 15 splinters x 0.2	weapon.txt item Plank / normal.txt item Splinters
assume	vanilla CarveMediumHandlesFromPlank 1 plank -> 6 Handle, CarveSmallHandlesFromPlank -> 12 SmallHandle	recipes_carving.txt; caps Handle 2, SmallHandle 1 keep plank->handles->splinters below 15. tools/check_loops.py finds new loops after an update
assume	TwigsBundle = 12 Twigs	recipes_packing.txt stack_items/unstack_items
assume	SmokingPipe is one item for both the carved wooden pipe and the kiln clay pipe	recipes_carving.txt:440, craftrecipe_kiln.txt:400; a clay pipe also breaks into 1 splinter
assume	SkillRequired = Woodwork:5 on WoodScraps_PressPlank uses the Woodwork perk id	vanilla recipes_carpentry.txt uses "SkillRequired = Woodwork:N"
